title: The sine Gordon equation in light-cone coordinates on the half lines revisited: a Riemann--Hilbert approach
summary: In this work, we study the initial boundary value (IBV) problems for the sine-Gordon (sG) equation in the light-cone coordinates $u_{xt}=\sin u$ in the quarter planes $x> 0$, $t>0$ and $x 0$ assuming a suitable decay as $x\to +\infty$ or as $x\to -\infty$. Employing the Riemann--Hilbert (RH) problem framework, we demonstrate that these two IBV problems differ significantly with respect to the boundary data required for well-posedness.
